fixes.explanation: That's it, friend. Verse 17 says the midwives feared God and did not do as the king had instructed. Think about that. The king of Egypt gave the order, and he's the most powerful man around. And these two women hear it and just don't do it. Whatever Pharaoh had, the text says their fear of God counted for more.

You've got it, baker! Verse 21 says, “And because the midwives feared God, He gave them families of their own.” Look at who they spent their days helping: other women's babies. Shiphrah and Puah brought life in at every birth, and then God gave them families of their own. I think that's about the sweetest ending a midwife could get. I'd be hugging every one of them, with my mustache.
